sloka: कैकेयीमब्रवीत्क्रुद्धः प्रदहन्निव चक्षुषा ।नृशम्से दुष्टचारित्रे कुलस्यास्य विनाशिनि ॥२-१२-७॥
transliteration: kaikeyīmabravītkruddhaḥ pradahanniva cakṣuṣā ।nṛśamse duṣṭacāritre kulasyāsya vināśini ॥2-12-7॥

translations.english: O woman of cruel and sinful nature, you are bent on destroying this family. What harm has been done to you by Rama or by me?
